quarterly_data.quarter: PDF Solutions press release: Introducing Exensio Aurora: PDF Solutions Unveils (09-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: PDF Solutions unveiled Exensio Aurora, a new Exensio analytics architecture built to handle semiconductor manufacturing data at petabyte scale and to deploy agentic AI across manufacturing operations and the supply chain; the company says it began investing in it more than a year ago at the urging of several of its customers. Its distributed engine 'is designed to deliver approximately 25X faster performance at comparable hardware cost', with a Manufacturing Data House for 3D and higher-dimensional data, model lifecycle management built on Kubernetes (central training with deployment to OSATs, test floors and edge boxes) and LLM-enabled agents with on-premise options. CEO John Kibarian ties it to 3D architecture and hybrid packaging creating a larger and more complex global supply chain; PDF says that in most cases less than 5% of semiconductor manufacturing data is analyzed with conventional tools. Availability: first available in September 2026 as a beta release for a small number of early adopters; first public demonstrations at PDF Solutions CONNECT 2026 on October 15-16.
quarterly_data.figure: approximately 25X faster performance at comparable hardware cost; beta for early adopters in September 2026
